directives.title: Reflect in the projectile layer
directives.acceptance: parried petal flies back and can soak the shooter with owner/team swapped; gravity>=6 lobs bypass guard; reflected kills credited to blocker

challenge_for_mikel: Should Guard be universal or melee-only? Universal = forgiving, chess-like, longer matches; melee-only = sharp class identity and real RPS but week-one 'blades are unfair' screaming. Decide before Directive 2, because it determines whether Stamina lives on the saber or on the player. Secondary dare: is a reflected shot funnier than a blocked one? If yes, reflect should be the default guard outcome and absorb the failure case.
